en: A book or set of books that gives information on many subjects, or on one subject in detail.
ex: I looked up the topic in an encyclopedia.
我在百科全書裡查了這個主題。

en: A vote in which all the people in a country or area are asked to decide on one important question.
ex: The country held a referendum on joining the union.
該國舉行了是否加入聯盟的公投。

en: A short, well-known saying that gives advice or states something that is generally true.
ex: There is a proverb that says "Practice makes perfect."
有句諺語說「熟能生巧」。

en: A pleasant smell; or a liquid used to give a pleasant smell to the body.
ex: The fragrance of roses filled the garden.
玫瑰的芬芳瀰漫了整座花園。

en: To make someone unable to hear by a very loud noise.
ex: The music was so loud that it nearly deafened us.
音樂大聲得幾乎讓我們耳聾。

en: Friendly, helpful feelings toward others; or the good reputation of a business as part of its value.
ex: The gift was a gesture of goodwill between the two companies.
這份禮物是兩家公司之間善意的表示。

en: To manage and organize the work of a company or institution; or to give medicine or a punishment.
ex: The nurse administered the medicine to the patient.
護理師給病人用藥。

en: To remove dirt or harmful substances from something to make it clean.
ex: The filter purifies the water before you drink it.
濾水器在你喝水前把水淨化。

en: A very difficult or unpleasant experience that tests your strength.
ex: The hostages survived a terrible ordeal.
人質們熬過了一段可怕的磨難。

en: Relating to a scale of temperature where water freezes at 0 degrees and boils at 100.
ex: Water boils at one hundred degrees Celsius.
水在攝氏一百度時沸騰。

en: The act of leaving your own country to live permanently in another.
ex: Poverty led to mass emigration from the region.
貧窮導致該地區大量人口外移。

en: A short story with a moral, often featuring animals that talk and behave like humans.
ex: The fable of the tortoise and the hare teaches patience.
龜兔賽跑的寓言教導人耐心。

en: The first form of something new, from which later versions are developed.
ex: The engineers built a prototype of the new car.
工程師們製作了新車的原型。

en: A soft, gentle song sung to help a baby go to sleep.
ex: The mother sang a lullaby to her baby.
媽媽對著嬰兒唱了一首搖籃曲。

en: An instrument for measuring the amount or size of something; or to judge or measure something.
ex: The survey was used to gauge public opinion.
這項調查是用來評估民意的。

en: A king, queen or emperor who rules a country.
ex: The monarch opened Parliament with a speech.
君主以演說為國會揭幕。

en: To think that something is smaller, less important or less able than it really is.
ex: Never underestimate the power of a good education.
千萬別低估良好教育的力量。

en: A thick liquid that you rub into your skin to keep it soft or protect it.
ex: She rubbed some lotion into her dry hands.
她把一些乳液抹到乾燥的雙手上。

en: One of the short hairs that grow along the edge of your eyelid.
ex: She has long, dark eyelashes.
她有著又長又黑的睫毛。

en: Enjoying being with other people; friendly.
ex: He is a sociable man who loves going to parties.
他是個喜歡參加派對的好交際的人。

en: A person's height; or the importance and respect a person has because of their achievements.
ex: He was a man of great stature in the community.
他在社區中是個很有聲望的人。

en: Clever at getting what you want in a secret or dishonest way.
ex: The fox is known as a sly animal in many stories.
在許多故事裡，狐狸被描寫成狡猾的動物。

en: A person who plays the violin.
ex: The young violinist played with great skill.
這位年輕的小提琴家演奏技巧高超。

en: A hard silver-white metal used to make coins and mix with other metals; or a US coin worth five cents.
ex: A nickel is worth five cents in the United States.
在美國，一個鎳幣價值五分錢。

en: A written or printed copy of something spoken; or an official record of a student's grades.
ex: Please submit your official transcript with your application.
請把你的正式成績單與申請文件一起提交。

en: To consider one thing as equal to or the same as another; or to be equal to something.
ph: 把 A 等同於 B
money does not equate to happiness
ex: Don't equate being quiet with being unfriendly.
別把安靜與不友善混為一談。

en: To make something more modern by using new methods, equipment or ideas.
ex: The company plans to modernize its old factories.
公司計畫讓其舊工廠現代化。

en: To say that something is true or that someone has done something wrong, without proof.
ex: The newspaper alleged that the minister had taken bribes.
報紙指控部長收受賄賂。

en: Allowed by the rules or the law.
ex: Smoking is not permissible in the building.
大樓裡不允許吸菸。

en: A small flat box or bag; or a unit of data sent over a network.
ex: She bought a packet of biscuits from the shop.
她在店裡買了一包餅乾。

en: An area of wet, soft land; or to overwhelm someone with too much to do.
ex: The crocodiles live in the swamp near the river.
鱷魚棲息在河邊的沼澤地。

en: A person whose job is to look after a building or land; or someone who takes care of a person.
ex: The caretaker locks the school gates every evening.
管理員每天晚上鎖學校大門。

en: The quality of being exact and accurate.
ex: The surgeon worked with great precision.
外科醫生以極高的精確度進行手術。

en: A bird kept for its meat or eggs, such as a chicken or duck; or any wild bird.
ex: Ducks and geese are types of water fowl.
鴨和鵝是水禽的種類。

en: A person who claims to be able to know things about the future by special mental powers; or relating to the mind.
ex: She visited a psychic who told her about her future.
她去找了一位靈媒，對方告訴她未來的事。

en: A large room or building where concerts, plays or speeches are held.
ex: The graduation ceremony was held in the school auditorium.
畢業典禮在學校禮堂舉行。

en: A game in which people buy numbered tickets and win prizes if their number is chosen.
ex: He won a million dollars in the lottery.
他在樂透中贏得了一百萬元。

en: Away from the coast or border; in the central part of a country; or happening within a country.
ex: The town lies about fifty miles inland from the coast.
這座小鎮位於離海岸約五十英里的內陸。

en: The state of being unable to stop doing or using something, especially something harmful.
ex: He is trying to overcome his addiction to gambling.
他正努力戒除賭癮。

en: To make something look larger than it is; or to make something seem more important than it is.
ex: The microscope magnifies objects up to a thousand times.
這台顯微鏡能把物體放大到一千倍。
